reason: Proof via the Fourier side: f in L^1 gives continuity of hat f; x^alpha f in L^1 for |alpha|<=s gives C^s regularity near zero by the published differentiation identity, and the little-o decay of the preceding item forces all derivatives through order s to vanish; the geometric argument is the standard graded Taylor comparison, documented in the strategy. Statement is the classical consequence recorded by Bownik-Wang p. 2299 and W Proposition 6.10(b).
